body.title: The build implement prompts
body.summary: Add the digest and the first action to both build implement renderers (renderImplementPrompt and renderStandaloneImplementPrompt in src/daemon/steps/build-step/render.ts) through a new placeholder in src/prompts/build/implement-task.md that begins the Process with the Epic impact analysis and tells the builder the BUILD summary must open with a paragraph labelled EPIC_IMPACT_LABEL naming each Story the LLD's analysis covered, repeated in its final validate call, and that BUILD approval is refused without it; a first or standalone Story gets only the one-line 'does not apply'. Refresh inventory fixtures only for what this task changes. Tests in render.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: the task implement prompt and the standalone implement prompt for a later Story begin their Process with the Epic impact analysis and the digest and tell the builder about the labelled paragraph, the final validate call and the approval refusal
for a first or standalone Story the prompts gain only the one-line 'does not apply'
the existing render tests still pass and no inventory test case fails beyond the four that already fail on a clean checkout

tests.name: render.test.ts: the build implement prompt for a later Story begins its Process with the Epic impact analysis and the digest and tells the builder to open its BUILD summary with a paragraph labelled EPIC_IMPACT_LABEL naming each covered Story and that BUILD approval is refused without it, and for a first or standalone Story gains only the one-line 'does not apply'
